questions.questionText: Consider the names of the following Mughal Emperors of the Eighteenth century: (i) Alamgir II (ii) Ahmad Shah (iii) Jahandar Shah (iv) Muhammad Shah. Which among the following sequences represents the correct chronological order?
questions.explanation: Chronology of 18th-century later Mughal emperors: (iii) Jahandar Shah (1712-1713) -> (iv) Muhammad Shah 'Rangeela' (1719-1748) -> (ii) Ahmad Shah Bahadur (1748-1754) -> (i) Alamgir II (1754-1759).

questions.questionText:
Match List-I (Wars / Treaties) with List-II (Associated Events):
List-I:
(A) First Anglo-Maratha War
(B) Second Anglo-Maratha War
(C) Third Anglo-Maratha War
(D) Treaty of Salbai
List-II:
1. Treaty of Bassein
2. Warren Hastings
3. Lord Hastings & Abolition of Peshwa
4. Treaty of Purandhar
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Bassein (1802) signed by Peshwa Baji Rao II with the British led directly to the Second Anglo-Maratha War (1803-1805), as Scindia and Bhonsle refused to accept British subsidiary alliance.
